files.README.md:
# java-sql-sqlite-no-interfaces-services-tests

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories with their own SQL over a JDBC `Connection`, and services, in Java 21. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no framework.

## Settings

- Database: sqlite.
- Entities: written for every table.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch<T> per field: absent, null or a value.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/main/java/app/Database.java        the JDBC connection to DATABASE_URL
src/main/java/app/Sql.java             how the repositories run SQL: values, rows and refusals
src/main/java/app/UnitOfWork.java      the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/main/java/app/errors/              NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/main/java/app/entities/            one entity per table
src/main/java/app/repositories/        the repositories of each table
src/main/java/app/services/            one service per table
src/test/java/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                   what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
mvn test                                          # SQLite in target/
TEST_DATABASE_URL=jdbc:sqlite:app.db?foreign_keys=true mvn test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

`Database.open()` opens one connection, which is fine for trying the code; in production give the unit of work connections from a pool such as HikariCP.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <groupId>app</groupId>
  <artifactId>java-sql-sqlite-no-interfaces-services-tests</artifactId>
  <version>0.1.0</version>
  <description>Data access layer (entities, repositories and services) generated by DB2CRUD.</description>

  <properties>
    <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
  </properties>

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.xerial</groupId>
      <artifactId>sqlite-jdbc</artifactId>
      <version>3.54.1.0</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
      <version>6.1.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>

  <build>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>3.5.4</version>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>
